bfl--flux-2-pro--generate-images: Generates an image from text and up to 9 reference images, at 256–2048 px per side.
byteplus--seedance-2-fast-reference--gen: Fast tier of Seedance 2.0: mixes up to 9 images, 3 videos and 3 audio clips into a 4–15 second video at 480p or 720p.
byteplus--seedance-2-fast-text-to-video-: Fast tier of Seedance 2.0: turns a prompt alone into a 4–15 second clip with synchronized audio, at 480p or 720p.
byteplus--seedance-2-reference--generate: Standard (non-Fast) Seedance 2.0: combines a prompt with up to 9 images, 3 videos and 3 audio clips into one video.
byteplus--seedance-2-text-to-video--gene: Standard (non-Fast) Seedance 2.0 from text only: a 4–15 second clip with synchronized audio, in seven aspect ratios or adaptive.
byteplus--seedream-4--edit-images: Edits your source images from a text instruction, using up to 10 reference images, at output sizes up to 4096×4096.
byteplus--seedream-4--generate-images: Generates images from a text prompt at sizes up to 4096×4096, and can return a batch of related images in one run.
byteplus--seedream-4-5--edit-images: Edits source images with the 4.5 model, which outputs at least 3.68 MP and up to 4096×4096.
byteplus--seedream-4-5--generate-images: Generates images from text with the 4.5 model at a minimum of 3.68 MP, with optional batch output of related images.
byteplus--seedream-5-lite--edit-images: Edits images from an instruction with up to 14 reference images, saved as PNG or JPEG at sizes up to 3072×3072.
byteplus--seedream-5-lite--generate-imag: Generates images from text at up to 3072×3072 (3K) as PNG or JPEG, with optional batch generation of related images.
byteplus--seedream-5-pro--edit-images: Pro-model editing with up to 10 references, giving 1K, 1.5K or 2K images as PNG or JPEG.
byteplus--seedream-5-pro--generate-image: Generates one image from text on the Pro model at 1K, 1.5K or 2K; no batch output.
gemini--omni-1.1-flash--animate-images: Animates a starting image into a 3–10 second video with audio on the 1.1 release, from 360p up to 4K.
gemini--omni-1.1-flash--edit-videos: Edits an existing video from a written instruction on the 1.1 release, and can keep refining the same clip over several turns.
gemini--omni-1.1-flash--generate-videos: Writes a 3–10 second video with audio from a prompt alone on the 1.1 release, landscape or portrait, at 360p to 4K.
gemini--omni-flash-preview--animate-imag: Preview release: turns a still image into a 3–10 second video with sound, from a 360p draft up to 4K.
gemini--omni-flash-preview--edit-videos: Preview release: changes an existing video from a text instruction, and later turns can adjust the same clip.
gemini--omni-flash-preview--generate-vid: Preview release: creates a video with sound from text only, 16:9 or 9:16, at 360p, 720p, 1080p or 4K.
kling--text-to-video--generate-videos: Generates a video from a prompt of up to 2,500 characters in 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1, with an optional negative prompt and camera control.
krea--krea-2-large--generate-images: Photorealism-focused Krea 2 model: renders expressive photographic images from text, with an optional Krea moodboard and style references.
krea--krea-2-medium--generate-images: Illustration-focused Krea 2 model: draws expressive illustrations from text, steered by up to 10 style reference images.
luma--ray-2-text-to-video--generate-vide: Generates a 5 or 9 second video from text at 540p to 4K, in seven aspect ratios including 21:9, with an option to loop.
luma_2--uni-1-image-generation--generate: Generates an image from text and up to 9 reference images, in ratios from 3:1 to 1:3, with a manga style and optional web search.
openai--gpt-image-2--generate-images: Generates images from text at low, medium or high quality, with transparent or opaque backgrounds and sizes up to 3840×2160.
openai--gpt-image-2.5-flare--generate-im: Flare variant of GPT Image 2.5: renders text inside images, with five quality levels including standard and HD.
openai--gpt-image-2.5-sunburst--generate: Sunburst variant of GPT Image 2.5: PNG, WebP or JPEG output, transparent backgrounds, and sizes up to 3840×2160.
qwen--qwen-image-3.0-image-edit--edit-im: Edits one to three input images from a text instruction, returning up to 6 results per run with optional prompt rewriting.
qwen--qwen-image-3.0-pro-image-edit--edi: Higher-quality Pro tier of Qwen Image 3.0 editing: takes one to three images plus an instruction and an optional negative prompt.
recraft--v3-text-to-vector--generate-ima: Generates an SVG from a prompt of up to 1,000 characters, with optional vector substyles such as line art, engraving and linocut.
recraft--v4-text-to-vector--generate-ima: Generates up to 6 SVG illustrations per run from prompts as long as 10,000 characters, in square, landscape or portrait sizes.
recraft--v4.1-pro-text-to-image--generat: Pro raster tier of V4.1: up to 6 images per prompt at 2048×2048, or wide and tall formats such as 2688×1536.
recraft--v4.1-pro-text-to-vector--genera: Pro tier of V4.1 vector output: SVG illustrations from text in seven aspect ratios, including 1:1, 16:9 and 9:16, up to 6 per run.
recraft--v4.1-text-to-image--generate-im: Standard raster tier of V4.1: up to 6 images per prompt at 1024×1024, or wide and tall sizes such as 1344×768.
recraft--v4.1-text-to-vector--generate-i: Standard V4.1 vector model: turns a text prompt into scalable SVG artwork in square, landscape or portrait ratios.
recraft--v4.1-utility-pro-text-to-image-: Utility Pro raster variant: images from text at 2048×2048, 2560×1664 or their portrait versions, up to 6 per run.
recraft--v4.1-utility-pro-text-to-vector: Utility Pro vector variant: produces SVG files from a prompt at an aspect ratio you choose, such as 3:2, 4:3 or 9:16.
recraft--v4.1-utility-text-to-image--gen: Utility raster variant at standard resolution: images from text at 1024×1024, 1280×832 or 832×1280, up to 6 per run.
recraft--v4.1-utility-text-to-vector--ge: Utility vector variant: creates SVG illustrations from a text prompt of up to 10,000 characters.
vertexai--gemini-2.5-flash-image--edit-i: Edits an uploaded image from a text instruction on Gemini 2.5 Flash Image, with up to 14 reference images.
vertexai--gemini-2.5-flash-image--genera: Text-to-image on Gemini 2.5 Flash Image, the original Nano Banana model, in ten fixed aspect ratios or auto.
vertexai--gemini-3-pro-image--edit-image: Edits images on Gemini 3 Pro Image and returns them at 1K, 2K or 4K, guided by optional reference images and documents.
vertexai--gemini-3-pro-image--generate-i: Generates high-quality images from text on Gemini 3 Pro Image at a chosen 1K, 2K or 4K resolution.
vertexai--gemini-nano-banana-2--edit-ima: Edits images on Gemini 3.1 Flash Image using up to 14 references, with 1K, 2K or 4K output and minimal or high thinking.
vertexai--gemini-nano-banana-2--generate: Generates images from text on Gemini 3.1 Flash Image at up to 4K, with an adjustable thinking level (minimal or high).
vertexai--veo-3--animate-images: Animates a starting image into a 4, 6 or 8 second video with optional native audio, at 720p, 1080p or 4K in 16:9 or 9:16.
vertexai--veo-3--generate-videos: Generates a 4, 6 or 8 second video from a text prompt alone, with native audio and an optional negative prompt, at up to 4K.
wan--happyhorse-video-edit--edit-videos: Edits an uploaded video from a prompt, guided by up to 5 reference images, at 720P or 1080P in five aspect ratios.
wan--text-to-video--generate-videos: Generates a 5, 10 or 15 second video from text, with optional driving audio and single-shot or multi-shot output with cuts.
wan--text-to-video-2.7--generate-videos: Generates a 2–15 second video from text at 720P or 1080P, with an optional audio track to drive it and a negative prompt.
wan--video-edit-2.7--edit-videos: Edits an uploaded video from a prompt with up to 4 reference images, can keep the original audio, and outputs 2–10 seconds.
wavespeed--seedvr2-image--edit-images: Upscales a single image to 2K, 4K or 8K with the SeedVR2 model, saved as JPEG, PNG or WebP.
wavespeed--ultimate-image-upscaler--edit: Raises one image to a 2K, 4K or 8K target with the Ultimate upscaler, as JPEG, PNG or WebP.
xai--grok-imagine-video--animate-images: Animates a start image into a 1–15 second video at 480p or 720p from a prompt.
xai--grok-imagine-video--generate-videos: Generates a 1–15 second video from text alone at 480p or 720p, in seven aspect ratios.
xai--grok-imagine-video-1.5--animate-ima: Turns a start image into a 1–15 second clip at up to 1080p, above the original's 720p.
xai--grok-imagine-video-1.5--generate-vi: Generates a 1–15 second video from a text prompt at 480p, 720p or 1080p, in aspect ratios from 1:1 to 16:9 and 9:16.
